sub_sector.value: asset-based truckload carrier; regional and dedicated truckload

logistics_role.detail: Truckload freight for food, consumer goods, retail, manufacturing and paper/packaging shippers, over the road and regional.

asset_intensity.detail: Owns a large fleet of newest trucks, with company drivers and regional shop maintenance facilities.

value_added.detail: Mainly truckload transport, plus dedicated round-trip service, DC transfers and store replenishment for shippers.

notes: Asset intensity rests on the evidence about its trucks, drivers and maintenance shops, since the pages don't say it outright.
